-- REQ: LANG-551 LANG-552 LANG-553 LANG-554
module Main exposing (main)

import Html exposing (Html, text)

{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
type Shape
    = Circle Float
    | Rect Float Float

area : Shape -> Float
area shape =
    case shape of
        Circle r ->
            pi * r ^ 2

        Rect w h ->
            w * h

main : Html msg
main =
    let
        name = "world\u{1F600}"
        c = 'x'
        doc = """multi "quoted"
line"""
    in
    text ("Hello, " ++ name ++ String.fromFloat (area (Circle 1.5)) ++ String.fromInt 0x1F)
